title: 听力挑战 · 数据分析讨论

rounds.speaker: 同事
rounds.line: How many users tried the new feature this month so far?
rounds.lineCn: 这个月到现在有多少用户试用了新功能?

grammar.name: 限定词 half 的用法
grammar.note: half of 表示'一半',常用于回答数量问题。

options.text: About half of them gave it a try.
options.feedback: half of 准确回答数量,表达自然。

options.text: Each user was given a free month.
options.feedback: 谈赠送活动,没有回答试用人数。

options.text: Most of the data was collected last year.
options.feedback: 谈数据收集时间,答非所问。

rounds.speaker: 同事
rounds.line: What does the survey tell us about the market this year?
rounds.lineCn: 今年的调查告诉了我们市场的什么情况?

grammar.name: 数量词 a number of
grammar.note: a number of 后接可数名词复数,表示'许多'。

options.text: A large number of young people prefer online shopping.
options.feedback: a number of 加复数名词,用法正确。

options.text: All the data was stored in a safe place.
options.feedback: 谈数据存放,没有回答市场信息。

options.text: The market was closed last Sunday.
options.feedback: 谈市场歇业,与调查结论无关。

rounds.speaker: 同事
rounds.line: Which figure stands out in the chart the most this week?
rounds.lineCn: 这周图表里哪个数据最突出?

grammar.name: 限定词 nearly all of
grammar.note: nearly all of 表示'几乎全部',限定所修饰的名词。

options.text: Nearly all of the growth came from the north.
options.feedback: nearly all of 限定范围,说明突出数据准确。

options.text: The chart was printed in black and white.
options.feedback: 谈图表打印样式,没有回答数据问题。

options.text: The north is colder than the south.
options.feedback: 谈地理气候,与数据图表无关。
